name: @print-partner/server

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/atomic-package-build.mjs --project tsconfig.build.json --copy src/data data --require-file data/ambrosia_fallback.json --require-file data/assistant-domain/_global/alias_map.yaml --require-file data/assistant-domain/_global/merge_conflicts.yaml --require-file data/assistant-domain/_global/pitfalls.md --require-file data/assistant-domain/_global/stacks.yaml --require-file data/assistant-domain/sources/README.md --require-file data/kit-catalog.yaml --require-file data/legal/ATTRIBUTION.md --require-file data/legal/LICENSE --require-file data/legal/LICENSE-SUMMARY.md --require-file data/legal/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md --require-file data/manifests/registry-index.yaml --require-file data/path-hints.yaml --require-file data/postgres/0000_init.sql --require-file data/printer_presets.json
scripts.test:ci: vitest run --exclude src/services/accepted-stl-bundle.test.ts && vitest run src/services/accepted-stl-bundle.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism

description: Print Partner Fastify API — SQLite/Postgres, jobs, MCP attach, printer/Spoolman/slicer integrations.
